Electronics $210,000 $245,850 $850,400 $227,925 3.73 97.9

Software $120,000 $156,750 $310,500 $138,375 2.24 162.9
Total Inventory $543,000 $634,400 $1,766,800 $588,700 3.00 121.7

Report Analysis

The inventory turnover ratio measures how many times a company sells and replaces its inventory during a period. A higher ratio generally indicates strong sales and effective inventory management.

Office supplies show the highest turnover ratio (4.62), indicating efficient management of this category. Furniture has the lowest ratio (2.31), suggesting potential overstocking or slower sales velocity.

For more information on inventory analysis metrics, visit the Corporate Finance Institute guide.
